svg.text: 1. Fresh original dimensions; book companion parts and AVI were unavailable.
2. Custom parts: cast stainless specified by book; ferritic stainless 7.70 g/cm3 is a mass proxy, grade unspecified.
3. Fasteners: ISO 4762 nominal M4x20, M6x40, M5x40; cosmetic threads, no strength class.
4. 18 occurrences / 12 part roles. Four independent educational motions: yaw, pitch, wrist, symmetric jaws.
5. Nominal dimensions in mm; third-angle projection. No manufacturing tolerances or load rating assigned.
